x: Minicoy, locally known as Maliku, is an island in Lakshadweep, India. Along with Viringili, it is on Maliku atoll, the southernmost atoll of Lakshadweep archipelago. Administratively, it is a census town in the Indian union territory of Lakshadweep.

It is an island-level administrative constituency governed by the Hoarafushi Island Council.

Administratively, Thiladhunmathi Atoll together with the Miladhunmadulu group consist of the administrative divisions of Haa Alif Atoll, Haa Dhaalu Atoll, Shaviyani Atoll and Noonu Atoll.
